name: paperformat-ai
description: Codex-driven deterministic academic formatting with governed template inputs, DOCX repair, conservative LaTeX migration, rendering, and integrity proof.

interface.shortDescription: Safely format papers for journals and conferences.
interface.longDescription: Resolve the exact venue, year, track, and official template before editing. Use deterministic, integrity-checked repair for Word manuscripts and a conservative compile-and-review workflow for LaTeX projects. Never guess missing rules or silently rewrite research content.
capabilities: Academic DOCX format checking and deterministic repair
defaultPrompt: Check my paper against the exact official venue template without changing research content.
Migrate this manuscript to the target journal or conference format and show the plan first.
Audit this LaTeX submission for venue formatting and compile it without rewriting the paper.
